question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A glass container to keep fish
solution:
The correct answer is '**Aquarium**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Aquarium**'.
 
• It means 'a glass container filled with water, in which fish and water animals are kept'. (पानी से भरी शीशे की टंकी जिसमें मछली आदि जलजीवों को रखा जाता है; मछलीघर, जलजीवशाला)
 
 
• *Example: The **aquarium** has many tanks of fish.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Aquarium.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Beaker**: a plastic or paper drinking cup, usually without a handle. (प्‍लास्टिक या काग़ज़ का प्रायः घुंडी रहित कप, चषक)
 
• **Vase**: a container that is used for holding cut flowers. [पुष्‍प-पात्र (पात्र जिसमें फूल काट-छाँट कर रखे जाते हैं) गुलदान]
 
• **Atrium**: a large high open space in the centre of a modern building. (किसी आधुनिक इमारत के मध्य भाग में स्थित बड़ा या ऊँचा प्रांगण)
